requiredBehavior: Automatic resident verification admits work only under a verifiable aggregate memory, swap, task/process, concurrency, wall-time, and output envelope that preserves interactive host headroom. Caches, queues, telemetry, and history have declared bounds. Stale work is coalesced/cancelled before expansion. If enforcement, resource completion, or cleanup cannot be established, the exact obligation remains pending as structured UNKNOWN/resource evidence, never PASS or semantic FAIL.
summary: Resident semantic/verification state must remain useful through an agent workday without unbounded cache/history growth or verifier pressure that can consume workstation headroom. On 2026-09-22 the user reported a Fedora low-memory/OOM warning during mncs-cgroup-swap-probe-20260922.scope, kernel termination of that scope, and visible host RAM pressure. The agent cannot access the previous-boot journal; the exact incident cause is unproven.
title: Resident verification lacks proven host-resource self-protection
